nodes.description: Address stored as contract owner in Owned, set to msg.sender in constructor and read by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address in Owned, set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string set to SBK in the constructor.
Public token name string set to SpenceBuck in the constructor.
Public uint8 token decimals set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply minted to the deployer address in the constructor and reported by totalSupply().
Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, written by approve/approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom.
Pure helper performing c = a + b with an overflow require(c >= a) check.
Pure helper performing c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a) to prevent underflow.
Pure helper performing c = a * b with division-based overflow check.
Pure helper performing c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Constructor that initialises the owner state variable with msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner address in newOwner for later acceptance.
Two-step ownership handover finaliser, requires msg.sender == newOwner and resets newOwner to zero.
Deployer constructor that sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a hardcoded address and emits Transfer.
View returning _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
View returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no return-value check on the previous allowance.
Spends an allowance: debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to].
View returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance then calls receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract while forwarding msg.sender and data.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner escape hatch that invokes transfer on an arbitrary token contract for the owner's benefit.
Caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances, ownership checks and forwarded into external calls.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after an allowance write, enabling reentrancy into token state.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an unvalidated arbitrary contract address.
Balance/allowance debit via safeSub; underflow of the ledger values depends entirely on the helper require(b <= a).
Balance credit via safeAdd; overflow safety relies on the helper require(c >= a) check.
First addend parameter of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Second addend parameter of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Recipient address parameter of SpenceBuck.transfer.
Amount parameter of SpenceBuck.transfer.
Spender address parameter of SpenceBuck.approve.
Allowance amount parameter of SpenceBuck.approve.
Debited account parameter of SpenceBuck.transferFrom.
Credited account parameter of SpenceBuck.transferFrom.
Amount parameter of SpenceBuck.transferFrom.
Spender contract address parameter of SpenceBuck.approveAndCall, used as the external call target.
Allowance amount parameter of SpenceBuck.approveAndCall.
Arbitrary calldata bytes forwarded to the spender contract in SpenceBuck.approveAndCall.
Attacker-specifiable external token contract address parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
Amount parameter of SpenceBuck.transferAnyERC20Token.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the caller-supplied msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, making ownership acceptance caller-gated.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] using the caller-controlled address.
approve indexes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with the caller address.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], tying the caller to the allowance slot.
approveAndCall writes the caller's allowance and then forwards msg.sender into an external contract call.
SpenceBuck constructor writes the symbol state variable.
SpenceBuck constructor writes the name state variable.
SpenceBuck constructor writes the decimals state variable.
SpenceBuck constructor mints the full supply into _totalSupply.
SpenceBuck constructor credits balances of the hardcoded deployer address.
Owned constructor initialises the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stages the new address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and resets it to address(0).
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
transfer mutates balances of sender and recipient.
transferFrom mutates the from and to balances.
transferFrom decrements the caller's allowance.
transfer delegates the sender debit to SafeMath.safeSub.
transfer delegates the recipient credit to SafeMath.safeAdd.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transfer performs an unchecked-style ledger subtraction through the safeSub helper.
transferFrom performs ledger and allowance subtractions through the safeSub helper.
transfer performs a ledger addition through the safeAdd helper.
transferFrom performs a ledger addition through the safeAdd helper.
approveAndCall invokes an external contract function after mutating allowance state.
A malicious spender contract can reenter transfer from within receiveApproval while approveAndCall is still executing.
The receiveApproval callback can reenter transferFrom and consume allowances during the pending approveAndCall.
The reentrant callback can observe and mutate the allowed mapping written earlier in approveAndCall.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on a caller-supplied token contract.
An untrusted token contract invoked by the owner path can reenter SpenceBuck state during the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner and sends the withdrawn tokens to owner.
Parameter a flows into the safeAdd addition.
Parameter b flows into the safeAdd addition.
Recipient parameter to is credited in balances.
Amount parameter tokens drives the sender debit and recipient credit.
Spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping key.
Amount parameter becomes the stored allowance value.
from parameter selects the debited balance and allowance slot.
to parameter selects the credited balance.
tokens parameter drives the balance and allowance debits.
spender parameter becomes both the allowance key and the external call target.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance and forwarded to the callback.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary caller-supplied data bytes reach the external reentrancy-capable call.
tokenAddress parameter selects the untrusted contract that transferAnyERC20Token calls.
tokens parameter is forwarded as the argument of the external transfer call.

normalization_plan.reason: Transient arithmetic operand only meaningful as an argument of the safeAdd helper function.
Transient arithmetic operand only meaningful as an argument of the safeAdd helper function.
Recipient address exists solely to select the balance slot updated by transfer.
Amount value is only consumable inside the transfer logic and its arithmetic helpers.
Spender key is only used to index the allowance mapping inside approve.
Allowance value is only stored by approve.
Debited account argument is only referenced by transferFrom.
Credited account argument is only referenced by transferFrom.
Transfer amount is only consumed by transferFrom and its safe-math helpers.
Spender argument directly becomes the target of the reentrancy-prone external call site.
Allowance amount only exists to be stored and forwarded by approveAndCall.
Opaque calldata is forwarded straight into the external callback, so it binds to that unsafe operation.
Unvalidated contract address is the callee of the external transfer invocation.
Amount argument is only used to parameterise the owner-gated token withdrawal.
